selectionMethod.existingIndexFinding: The authorization case index contains Open WebUI target source only; external skill sources are not a second target code project.
selectionMethod.selectionRule: Select the first non-Open-WebUI-fork public project with a fixed legal source ref, explicit authorization policy, locatable entries, and two source-verifiable obligations; do not select by model performance.

candidates.reason: The project is not a fork, has an MIT license, and exposes owner-only plus superuser-override branches at compact read/update entry points with public regression tests.

officialSources.purpose: model-visible authorization entry and effect source

acquisition.transport: authenticated GitHub CLI against official REST contents and repository metadata endpoints
acquisition.initialRoutingIssue: The first raw-contents request used ambiguous PowerShell interpolation and returned HTTP 404. The endpoint was rebuilt with explicit formatting and succeeded; candidate selection and prior evidence were retained.
acquisition.exposureStatus: Public development source already read by the development agent; evaluator tests are archived separately and are not claimed held out.
